create_imagenet_test_files: create Imagenet-A test split files by mapping image paths and labels to numpy arrays
download_datasets: download and extract the Imagenet-A dataset archive from Berkeley to a specified root directory
remove_file_name_whitespace: remove whitespace from image file names in class folders for g_pathmgr compatibility
run_create_imagenet_a_script: run the script with input and output paths to generate VISSL-compatible test data files
review_ImagenetTargetMapper: review the ImagenetTargetMapper class that maps dataset class labels to ImageNet class indices
